'''''Medicago orbicularis''''' is a plant species found throughout the Mediterranean basin and along the European Black Sea coast. It forms a [[symbiosis|symbiotic]] relationship with the bacterium ''[[Sinorhizobium]] medicae'', which is capable of [[nitrogen fixation]]. Common names include '''blackdisk medick''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=MEOR2|taxon=Medicago orbicularis|accessdate=30 June 2015}}</ref> '''button clover''', '''button medick''', and '''round-fruited medick'''.

==Uses==
The seed pods are edible and are foraged between March and May in [[Israel]] ([[Palestine (region)|Palestine]]).<ref>{{cite book |editor-last=Tesdell |editor-first=Omar |title=Palestinian Wild Food Plants (النباتات البرية الغذائية الفلسطينية) |publisher=Markaz Khalīl al-Sakākīnī al-Thaqāfī |date=2018 |location=Rāmallāh |page=[https://archive.org/details/palwildfoodplants2018/page/n51/mode/2up 52] |language=en, ar |url=https://archive.org/details/palwildfoodplants2018/page/n1/mode/2up |isbn=978-9950-385-72-6 |oclc=1050944096}}</ref>
